title: 2021-03-23 Onboarding retro with Kombinera
content:
Date: 23rd March 2021

Attendees: Space team. from the DevOps team.

Space resources:

Github initial repo: inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-space-planner (github.com)

Azure DevOps: Summary - Overview (azure.com)

What was discussed

  • Azure DevOps & build logic

  • Azure Function and Basic Auth

  • Terraform

  • Contributing to IPEX DevOps

Azure DevOps& build logic

has most experience with Action and will use this for build logic. Azure artifacts feed discussed as way of consuming dependencies. as well talked about special case where ENHET planner uses Azure Artifacts for promoting entire app.

Azure Function and Basic Auth

Talked about possible improvement of Azure function with regard to what resources are considered as binary. Default implementation updated. For Space will order service principals for access to Azure subscription and one for implementing SSO for demo sites.

Terraform

Will be used to version handling of infrastructure.

Contributing to IPEX Default-CICD

Talked about contributing to default DevOps setup.
